notes.title: Patch 1.106
notes.content:
- Shop fixed (Everytime starting battle with dummu problem)
- Added new dash tutorial in the prologue
- Little rebalance of final Boss

notes.title: Patch 1.103
notes.content:
- Camera fixes
- Satanael Fixes
- Vlad fixes

New:
- New Boss - Satanael
- 3 new Special items: Sun turret, Chest and super fruit
- 4 new enemies 
- New infinity level for beating the records (with 2 new mobs)
- New arena level before fight with Final boss
- Rework all bossfights: Now you can use special items
- New interface at Boss fight, that shows you time until next box's spawn
-  Now pickup any items is much more conveniently
-  Now You can throw boxes without walking
- Added reverb and some decorations at Shop level
- Some map changes
- New secret
- 8 New achievements 

Bug fixes:
-Softlock on prologue
- Skulls destroy when The Shadow changes attack
- Vlad pet too much popups
- Fixed ball stuck on second prologue level
- Some visual changes on frozen city location
- Camera improvements
- Laser fades faster
- Now you can't go to the shop before you open it

notes.title: Release!!!
notes.content:
The moment came when Tohru was born! I've been working on this game for almost a year: I've been carrying it for all 9 months!
I am very glad that I alone managed to bring such a difficult project to release. Thanks to everyone who followed the development and especially thanks to everyone who purchased, I am eternally grateful to you
Play - https://store.steampowered.com/app/1547350/Toru/?beta=0

I will be even more happy if you leave a review after passing! It helps a lot to promote the game.

Expect some cool stuff in the near future (● '◡' ●)

notes.title: New location - Golden Forest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39882973/fc7c6688a9ba0a73272525f80bbe447dc232b87b.png[/img]
Finally, I finished the stage of preparing the content, collected everything in the game together. Which means it's time to do new things! One of these is a new location - the Golden Forest! Here new battles with new monsters and bosses will take place)
Gold nuggets in this forest appear directly from the ground, but this does not interest the rupura, since they have completely different values.
Also, this forest is guarded by something and very soon Torah and Nama will collide with him ...
